column2: Facing God's creation can mean facing what God made for what it is, or facing it also as His workmanship; only the second faces it as creation.
Repentance toward God is the return toward God, and away from one's own turning from His call or from His work, which is to bring to pass the immortality and eternal life of man.
A return toward God is not fulfilled while there is still something God has made, which the one returning can see, that he refuses to face for what it is and as His workmanship.
